chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام forbade hunting pigeons in the cities.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the Commander of the Faithful, Imam 'Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.بِالْأَمْصَارِ: in the cities or populated urban centers

ai.seo_question: Did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام forbid hunting pigeons in cities?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal prohibition from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding hunting pigeons in urban centers. It reflects concern for regulated conduct in shared public spaces and indicates a ruling connected to hunting in inhabited places.
